findings.contract_clause: SERVICE.md: Inputs — the Lean 4 proof evidence manifest
findings.detail: The atom returned a 200 OK status and a verdict of INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for malformed input instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity error.

notes: The atom correctly implements the verification logic and handles valid/invalid/sparse inputs as expected by the contract. However, it fails to implement proper HTTP error handling for malformed input, returning a 200 status with an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict instead of the required 422 status.
